0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers come in 3-0, first in the Northwest, on a three-game winning streak and 2-0 on the road, while the Utah Jazz are 1-4, have lost three straight, and sit 5th in the Northwest, 3 games back. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Robert Williams III (knee) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Lauri Markkanen listed as day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Trail Blazers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 124-114 win in Portland on March 13, 2026.
